nodes.name: felix waits with locked chest
nodes.description: Felix sits in a tavern booth with a small iron chest secured by a heavy lock beside him, signaling the chest's importance.
evidence: Felix sits in a corner booth. Beside him on the bench sits a SMALL IRON CHEST, its lid secured with a heavy iron lock.

nodes.name: felix declines his usual drink
nodes.description: When the tavern keeper offers Felix his usual order, Felix asks only for water, suggesting unusual caution or tension.
evidence:
FELIX
Water. Just water, please.

TAVERN KEEPER
Your usual, Master Adler?

nodes.name: sable confirms chest was brought
nodes.description: Sable focuses on the iron chest and acknowledges that Felix has brought it to the meeting.
evidence:
SABLE
You brought it.
Sable sits across from Felix, her eyes on the iron chest.

nodes.name: felix reveals he carries the key
aliases: felix reveals he carries the key
nodes.description: Felix states his philosophy of guarding valuables and shows that he keeps the chest's heavy iron key on a chain around his neck.
evidence: He reaches into the collar of his shirt and draws out a CHAIN. From the chain hangs a HEAVY IRON KEY that matches the chest's lock. He tucks it back inside his shirt.

FELIX
(touching the chest)
You keep what matters with you or you lose it.

nodes.name: sable warns about wren
nodes.description: Sable warns Felix that Wren will continue pursuing the matter involving the chest or its contents.
evidence:
SABLE
Wren will not let this rest.

nodes.name: felix refuses to sell to wren
aliases: felix refuses to sell to wren
nodes.description: Felix asserts that Wren cannot obtain the item because Felix will not sell it, clarifying his stance and control over the map.
evidence:
FELIX
Wren cannot take what I do not sell.

nodes.name: inspector holt approaches felix
nodes.description: Inspector Holt enters the tavern, identifies Felix, and comes directly to his table before sitting uninvited.
evidence: Holt sits without invitation.

HOLT
Mr. Adler. Good that I found you.
A figure enters: INSPECTOR HOLT (40s, tall, watchful eyes, leather folio under his arm). He scans the room, finds Felix, and crosses directly to the table.

nodes.name: holt warns of violent interest in map
aliases: holt warns of violent interest in map
nodes.description: Holt tells Felix that dangerous parties are seeking his map through criminal channels and advises him to take precautions.
evidence:
HOLT (CONT'D)
I will be plain. There are parties inquiring about your map. Not merchants -- the kind who take what they want. The inquiry came through a known fence. Someone wants that map badly enough to hire for it. I am telling you now so you can take precautions.

nodes.name: felix accepts warning cautiously
nodes.description: Felix, visibly still, thanks Holt and says he will be careful, indicating he takes the threat seriously.
evidence:
FELIX
(very still)
Thank you, Inspector. I will be careful.

nodes.name: felix guards chest while drinking
nodes.description: After receiving his water, Felix drinks while keeping one hand on the iron chest, underscoring his protectiveness.
evidence: The keeper returns with a cup of water and sets it before Felix. Felix drinks, one hand resting on the iron chest.

nodes.name: Felix Adler
nodes.description: A cautious man guarding a locked iron chest and the map associated with it.
evidence: Felix sits in a corner booth.

Mr. Adler. Good that I found you.

FELIX
